Century Regalia - Luxury Residential Project Details Company Profile: Century Real Estate, established in 1973, is a five-decade-old professional real estate company based in Bengaluru, India. Recognized as a pioneer in residential development, Century Real Estate is among the most trusted and reliable brands in Bangalore. The company has played a key role in developing Bengaluru's skyline, with properties across Banerghatta Road, Indiranagar, MG Road, and the Central Business Development area, and is now focusing on North Bengaluru. Project Overview: Century Regalia Century Regalia is an exclusive luxury residential development spanning 8.5 acres located in the coveted Indiranagar neighborhood of Bengaluru. The property dedicates 80% of its area to serene open spaces and exquisitely landscaped gardens, fostering tranquility. It is uniquely positioned adjacent to the 125-acre lush Karnataka Golf Association (KGA) Road. This enclave offers a seamless blend of nature and urban sophistication, providing residents with a rare sanctuary amidst the2 vibrancy of city life. Century Regalia stands as a testament to architectural brilliance and thoughtful design, crafted for those who demand nothing but the best. Project Address: Century Regalia, Golf Avenue, next to KGA Road, Indiranagar, Kodihalli, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560008. Amenities: Century Regalia offers a comprehensive suite of amenities: Core Amenities: Lounge, Restaurant, Spa / Sauna & Jacuzzi, Business Centre, Games Room, Salon, Infinity Pool, Sky Cafe, Sky Cabana. Mindfulness Amenities: Reflexology Pathway, Sculpture Garden, Pets Park, Art Wall. Action & Sports Amenities: Cricket Practice Net, Climbing Dome, Mini Golf, Squash Court.

Celestial 4 BHK Penthouse: Area 4780 – 5380 Sq.Ft, Price ₹18.5 Crore onwards.
